title: Surge Open world Superhero Game. Play on Web!
author: luka06111
selftext:
Hi guys. I posted about my game a while ago and it got some upgrades gameplay wise and quality wise. 2 chapters of the main story are "done" it's not done cause it was written by AI and it's shit. I'll rewrite most of it. But it's enough for now. Any bugs please reach out to me. I'm doing this in my free time juggling taking care of my son and the rest of life. You know. I'll put a small trailer in here and the link of the game is https://tinyurl.com/SurgeSuperhero name is placeholder too. 

Thank you for your attention I'm trying to do something that I've always imagined to play for now it ruins on PC and mobile. But maybe later I'll add more and more quality and functions that it may not run on mobile so we'll see.
